S0642.reason: Federal courts should abstain from deciding constitutional issues until state courts have had the opportunity to interpret the state statute.

S0122.reason: A person who helps plan a burglary and drives the perpetrator to the scene is liable as an accomplice to burglary even if he secretly intends to prevent the crime.

S0549.reason: Fetal hemoglobin has the same oxygen-binding properties as adult hemoglobin, so there would be no functional difference.
